meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the event is published
gaps: Open the QA mailboxes of the concerned vendors
Verify each concerned vendor receives exactly one invitation email
Verify the email contains the event title, close time, and link
Verify no other vendor receives the email
Verify no email is sent to a real supplier
